15 de septiembre de 1916: el primer comb: September 15, 1916: the first tank battle in history. Ground churned by months of artillery, Delville Wood blasted to splinters and the ruins of Flers.
20 de noviembre de 1917: cientos de tanq: November 20, 1917: hundreds of British tanks against the Hindenburg Line. Very wide trenches and belts of wire to the north, the village of Flesquières on the ridge and the German guns waiting.
24 de abril de 1918: el primer duelo ent: April 24, 1918: the first tank-versus-tank duel in history, Mark IV against A7V. Green spring fields, Aquenne Wood, the town and the hamlet of Cachy.
12 de septiembre de 1918: la primera gra: September 12, 1918: the first major American offensive, with the Renault FTs of the Tank Corps. Old trenches full of wire, woods and the village of Essey.
29 de octubre de 1936: el primer combate: October 29, 1936: the first tank battle of the Spanish Civil War. Captain Arman's Soviet T-26s drive into the whitewashed village in the middle of the La Sagra plain.
Febrero de 1937: la batalla por la carre: February 1937: the battle for the Valencia road. Trenches on the ridges, olive groves, Pingarrón hill and both sides' tanks fighting for every hill.
13 de octubre de 1937: los BT-5 del Regi: October 13, 1937: the BT-5s of the International Regiment charge across irrigated fields with infantry riding on top. The ditches slow them down and the anti-tank guns wait for them by the sugar mill.
Guerra del Chaco entre Bolivia y Paragua: Chaco War between Bolivia and Paraguay. Bolivian Vickers tanks attack the Paraguayan forts of Nanawa through the scrub: quebracho trees, thorn bushes, narrow trails and 45 °C heat.
13 de junio de 1944: el bocage normando,: June 13, 1944: the Normandy bocage, fields closed in by hedgerows on earth banks where a tank can't see 50 m. The 7th Armoured's Cromwells drive into the town and Michael Wittmann's Tiger waits for them on Hill 213.
12 de julio de 1943: la batalla de tanqu: July 12, 1943: the largest tank battle in history. Open wheat steppe, the railway, the Oktyabrsky state farm on the ridge, ravines (balkas) and anti-tank ditches. The T-34s charge at full speed to close the distance against the Tigers.
Octubre de 1942: Montgomery rompe la lín: October 1942: Montgomery breaks the Afrika Korps line. Open desert with low ridges (Kidney Ridge, Tel el Aqqaqir), little cover and long-range combat. Sandstorms blot out everything.
Diciembre de 1944: la ofensiva de las Ar: December 1944: the Ardennes offensive in the snow. The 101st's paratroopers, surrounded in Bastogne, hold out in the pine woods while the Panthers attack along the roads. Cold, fog and few hours of daylight.
Otoño de 1942: el 6.º Ejército alemán pe: Autumn 1942: the German 6th Army fights house to house against the Soviet 62nd Army, with the Volga at their backs. Blocks in ruins, the grain elevator, Pavlov's House and the Red October factory. "There is no land for us beyond the Volga."
Abril de 1945: el Ejército Rojo entra al: April 1945: the Red Army enters central Berlin. Avenues between burnt-out five-story buildings, the shattered Tiergarten with its flak tower, the Brandenburg Gate and the Reichstag, where the red flag was raised on April 30.
Mayo de 1945: los marines y el ejército: May 1945: the US Marines and Army attack the Shuri Line in the rain. Coral ridges full of caves and bunkers, red-tiled villages, palms and pines, and mud. The Japanese Chi-Has wait dug into the slopes.
Febrero de 1943: Rommel ataca por el pas: February 1943: Rommel attacks through the Kasserine Pass, between two ranges of bare mountains (the djebels). The Panzers and the Italian Centauro Division with their M13/40s and Semoventes overrun the US 1st Armored in its first major battle. Dry wadis, olive groves and stony ground.
Noche del 16 al 17 de junio de 1944: el: Night of June 16–17, 1944: the Japanese 9th Tank Regiment launches the largest tank attack of the Pacific against the Marines' beachhead. Cane fields, palms, the town of Charan Kanoa and the sugar mill, with Mount Tapochau behind.
Mayo de 1944: la cuarta batalla de Monte: May 1944: the fourth battle of Monte Cassino. The town of Cassino reduced to rubble by bombing, the railway station and, atop the hill, the ruins of the Benedictine abbey. The German paratroopers hold out for four months; Poles, British and French drive them out.
October 1937: the battle of Shanghai. The "800 Heroes" of the National Revolutionary Army defend the Sihang Warehouse by Suzhou Creek while the Zhabei district burns. Japanese Ha-Gos and Chi-Has advance through the streets against the Chinese Vickers.
El centro real de Corrientes, a escala:: The real downtown of Corrientes, to scale: Plaza Torrent, the Cathedral, Plaza Libertad, the Plaza España roundabout and the Pedro Ferré and 3 de Abril avenues. 86 m blocks and street-by-street fighting.
La Avenida Costanera General San Martín: The General San Martín Costanera Avenue along the Paraná, Camba Cuá Park, the Arazaty promenade and the head of the General Belgrano Bridge, at real scale.
La rotonda de la Ruta 12 y Av. Independe: The Route 12 and Av. Independencia roundabout, Mercosur plaza, the western neighborhoods, the Boca Unidos stadium and the open lots with ponds across the highway. Real streets, to scale.
El paso real a 3.832 m entre Mendoza y C: The real pass at 3,832 m between Mendoza and Chile: Christ the Redeemer of the Andes at the summit, the Argentine cliff road and the switchbacks on the Chilean side. Slopes many tanks can't climb.
Al pie del Cristo: At the foot of the Christ
Av. Independencia de doble mano entre el: Two-way Av. Independencia between the Carrefour, the Cinemacenter and the Children's Hospital, with the Villa Celia, Santa Teresita and Villa Chiquita neighborhoods on each side. Real streets, to scale.
El Aeropuerto Piragine Niveyro con su pi: Piragine Niveyro Airport with its runway, the Nolo Alías carnival stadium, Route 12 and the La Reina crossroads. Lots of open ground: long-range combat.
El pueblo de Laguna Brava, en las afuera: The village of Laguna Brava, on the outskirts of Corrientes, with the lagoon to the north, Route 12, 6 de Mayo plaza and small farms around. The shore has reeds and can be forded.
El pueblo de pescadores frente al Paraná: The fishing village on the Paraná, house by house as it is: the riverfront, the beach, the central plaza, the Coast Guard station and the Esperanza and Malvinas neighborhoods.
La Basílica de Nuestra Señora de Itatí y: The Basilica of Our Lady of Itatí and its 80 m dome on the Paraná bluff, the town block by block, the bus terminal and Ex Combatiente Guillermo Núñez plaza.
El oeste de Puerto Argentino frente a la: Western Stanley facing the harbor, the Museum, the Battle Memorial and the road to Sapper Hill, where fighting took place on June 14, 1982. Peat and rock, no trees.
El Puente General Belgrano real: 1,7 km: The real General Belgrano Bridge: 1.7 km over the Paraná between the Corrientes riverfront and the Chaco shore. It's the only way between the two cities.
El puente internacional San Roque Gonzál: The real San Roque González de Santa Cruz international bridge, 2.5 km over the Paraná, between San José Park in Posadas and the Encarnación riverfront.
La represa real sobre el río Uruguay: 2,: The real dam on the Uruguay River: 2.5 km of road along the dam wall between Concordia and Salto, with the lake above and the river below. It's the only crossing.
